parameters.help_en: The product entry region, which is determined by the selected region endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 产品入口地域，由所选地域端点确定
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The current routed workspace. The server verifies the account, region, and resource ownership. This parameter cannot be omitted or used to access other workspaces
parameters.help_zh: 当前路由的 Workspace，服务端校验账号、地域及资源归属；不允许省略或访问其他 Workspace
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required and cannot be empty. It is reserved to be compatible with the API. Currently, it does not provide the ability to deduplicate requests or recover the original result based on this field. If a timeout occurs or the result is unconfirmed, query the query cache status first before deciding whether to recommit
parameters.help_zh: 必填且非空，保留用于接口兼容。当前不提供基于此字段的请求去重或原结果恢复；超时或结果未确认时，先查询缓存状态，再决定是否重新提交
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow the current source reading and transfer to use the public network. At least one of this parameter and accessVpc must be set to true. The server verifies the access conditions of the current workspace
fields.help_zh: 允许本次源读取与转存使用公网；与 accessVpc 至少一项为 true，服务端校验当前 Workspace 的访问条件
fields.name: access_internet

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow the current source reading and transfer to use a VPC. At least one of this parameter and accessInternet must be set to true. The server parses the trusted network of the current workspace and does not modify the agent runtime network
fields.help_zh: 允许本次源读取与转存使用 VPC；与 accessInternet 至少一项为 true，服务端解析当前 Workspace 可信网络，不修改 Agent 运行网络
fields.name: access_vpc

fields.help_en: The ID of the source ACR Enterprise instance
fields.help_zh: 源 ACR 企业版实例 ID
fields.name: acr_instance_id

fields.help_en: The namespace of the source ACR
fields.name: namespace

fields.help_en: The name of the repository under the namespace. Do not include the namespace repeatedly
fields.help_zh: 命名空间下的仓库名，不重复包含命名空间
fields.name: repository

fields.help_en: The selected tag of the source image
fields.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The business parameters for creating an image cache
parameters.help_zh: 创建镜像缓存的业务参数
parameters.name: body

data.description_en: The result of creating the image cache

acrInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the source ACR Enterprise instance
acrInstanceId.description_zh: 源 ACR 企业版实例 ID

agentCount.description_en: The deduplicated number of agents that have useImageCache set to true and are associated with this logical resource in the current workspace. The value is greater than or equal to 0. This set is the same as the set filtered by imageCacheId in ListAllAgents. Agents with the feature disabled are not counted, and this value is independent of the number of occupied instances
agentCount.description_zh: 当前 Workspace 内 useImageCache=true 且关联本逻辑资源的 Agent 去重数，大于等于 0；与 ListAllAgents 的 imageCacheId 筛选同集合。关闭即不计入，与实例占用数量无关
agentCount.title_en: 使用缓存的 Agent 数量
agentCount.title_zh: 使用缓存的 Agent 数量

cacheSizeBytes.description_en: The actual cache size in bytes. The known value is greater than or equal to 0. If the value is unknown, it is null. The compressed size of the source image cannot be used as a substitute
cacheSizeBytes.description_zh: 实际缓存容量，已知值大于等于 0；未知为 null，不能用源镜像压缩大小代填

canDelete.description_en: Indicates whether deletion is allowed. The value is true when there are no configuration references with the switch enabled, no valid instances occupying the resource, and the resource is not being deleted in the current workspace. If the reference status is unknown, the query should fail, and deletion cannot be allowed by default
canDelete.description_zh: 当前 Workspace 无开启开关的配置引用且无有效实例占用、资源不在删除中时为 true。引用状态未知应使查询失败，不能默认允许

createdAt.description_en: The creation time of the logical resource in the current workspace, in RFC3339 format with time zone. The time is not refreshed when the content of the latest tag is updated
createdAt.description_zh: 当前 Workspace 逻辑资源创建时间，含时区 RFC3339 格式；latest 内容更新不刷新

deleteBlockReason.description_en: The reason why deletion is blocked. The value is null when canDelete is true. Otherwise, the value is returned based on the priority of DELETING, AGENT_ENABLED, and INSTANCES_RELEASING. Even if the number of agents is 0, old instances may still occupy the resource
deleteBlockReason.description_zh: canDelete=true 时为 null；否则按 DELETING、AGENT_ENABLED、INSTANCES_RELEASING 的优先级返回。Agent 数量为 0 仍可能有旧实例占用

digest.description_en: The current content digest in the format of sha256: followed by a 64-character lowercase hexadecimal string. It only describes the currently registered content and does not prove that old instances have been switched
digest.description_zh: sha256: 加 64 位小写十六进制；只描述当前登记内容，不证明旧实例已切换

error.description_en: The reason for the cache failure. This is a non-null object when the status is FAILED, and null for other statuses. It only describes the current content and the current creation round
error.description_zh: FAILED 时必为非空对象，其他状态为 null；只描述当前内容和当前制作轮次

code.description_en: The secure and non-null error code for the current creation failure
code.description_zh: 安全且非空的当前制作错误码

message.description_en: The secure and non-null display reason for the creation failure, excluding credentials, internal addresses, or stack traces
message.description_zh: 安全且非空的展示原因，不含凭证、内部地址或堆栈
message.example: 镜像缓存制作失败，请重试。

imageId.description_en: The logical resource ID manageable by the current workspace, which is not a shared physical cache ID
imageId.description_zh: 当前 Workspace 可管理的逻辑资源 ID，不是共享物理缓存 ID

registry.description_en: The domain name of the source image, excluding the protocol, path, and credentials

repository.description_en: The path of the source image repository in the namespace/repository format, which already includes the namespace

status.description_en: The status of the image cache. Valid values: PENDING: creating, READY: available, FAILED: abnormal, DELETING: deleting in the current workspace
status.description_zh: PENDING 创建中，READY 可用，FAILED 异常，DELETING 当前 Workspace 删除中

tag.description_en: The tag of the source image. Case is preserved. Regular tags cannot be registered with different digests, with the exact lowercase latest tag being the only exception
tag.description_zh: 保留大小写；普通 tag 不允许登记为不同 Digest，仅精确小写 latest 例外

workspaceId.description_en: The workspace ID, which is consistent with the requested workspace. Resources with the same content from other workspaces are not returned
workspaceId.description_zh: 与请求 Workspace 一致，禁止返回其他 Workspace 的同内容资源

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used for troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查问题
requestId.title_en: 请求 ID，用于排查问题。
requestId.title_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查问题。

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. This does not indicate that the cache creation is complete
success.description_zh: 请求是否成功，不代表缓存制作完成
success.title_en: 请求是否成功，不代表缓存制作完成。
success.title_zh: 请求是否成功，不代表缓存制作完成。
